decision.time_to_evidence: one completed twenty-person unique protocol owned by #336

recruitment.named_source: founder-managed professional network covering the five nuclei of the unique #336 sample: private engineering/construction/incorporation, expert evidence, property valuation, occupational safety, and current B2G buyers
eligibility_all_of: represents one declared nucleus of the unique #336 qualitative sample
can complete assigned tasks without coaching from implementers
gives explicit research consent separate from marketing
is not a CONFENGE team member or implementation contributor
exclusions_any_of: CONFENGE team member or implementation contributor
was coached on the navigation, evidence panel or offer wording
does not provide explicit research consent
recruitment.quota_policy: No result is calculated from fewer than twenty eligible, consented completions. The 8/3/3/3/3 split is a predeclared qualitative sample, not market share. Four or fewer people per nucleus is qualitative reading. Replacements must independently pass the same screen. A second study is forbidden.

privacy.private_store: access-controlled CONFENGE operations storage outside git, issues, analytics and _site

retention.aggregate_no_pii: versioned while the decision remains auditable

tasks.prompt: Voce recebeu um edital de obra publica e precisa avaliar riscos antes de decidir se participa. Onde procuraria?
Uma medicao da obra foi parcialmente glosada e voce precisa organizar a contestacao. Onde procuraria?
Um evento extraordinario elevou custos do contrato e voce precisa avaliar recomposicao. Onde procuraria?

protocols.approval_rule: At least 80% of participants complete each named task without moderator correction or explanation; at the minimum sample this is sixteen of twenty.
protocols.rejection_rule: Any task below 80% success is REPROVADO and requires an evidence-derived taxonomy proposal before retest.

protocols.stimulus: current production-equivalent first viewport of the CONFENGE home page at the bound git SHA
questions: Que problema ela ajuda a resolver?
O que voce faria em seguida?
Isto parece consultoria, software/produto, ou outra coisa? Por que?
protocols.approval_rule: At least 80% identify the audience, problem and plausible next action, and at least 80% do not misclassify the evidence panel as software/product; at the minimum sample this is sixteen of twenty.
protocols.rejection_rule: Any dimension below 80% success is REPROVADO; record the observed confusion before considering move-after-hero or replacement.

rollback.private_data: do not restore deleted participant data; preserve consent withdrawal and retention deletions
rollback.public_surface: no public URL, canonical, robots, runtime or conversion flow changes
